shots.purpose: The essayist's phrase set large over the emptiness it names - dispersing copper against cold points of light. Chang's name is not on screen beside it, which the attribution distinction requires. Set as a quote rather than a plate so three plates do not run together.

Show the whole series at once before the chain walks it, using the artist's own composite. The backdrop is a MOTION asset (g01's drift at this dim was too small to register as movement) and is NOT a02: a02 is a figure marked no_crop, and a backdrop covers, which cut its sequence apart and doubled the same picture at two scales.
Transformation one as the thing itself: a cent in circulation, worth what the Treasury says.
Transformation two is a severing, not an object: the link between the coin and its assigned value breaks on the word 'subverted'.

Transformation three as the APPARATUS, not the product: the copy stand, the lit pad with one cent on it, and the laptop showing the capture. The process is what the line names; an archival photograph was standing in for the archival photographing.

Transformation four as it actually happened: molten copper poured from the crucible into the block mould. Real footage of the casting replaces generated particulate - for a work about the objecthood of real things, the difference matters.
Transformation five as TEN THOUSAND inscriptions, one per sat - not one object inscribed.

states.caption: each penny inscribed on a sat

shots.purpose: The trading itself, as it actually appears: members of the set listed with their numbers and their prices in bitcoin.

The line that bridges the market to the closer, over the one Cent the essay singles out - an ordinary coin that time has turned into something else. Dust drifting behind it for the emergent half of the sentence.
Close on the coin the film opened on, under the essay's own words for what the work finally is.
